queryAlerts.name: AppInsights-AntiVirus-FileUploaded
queryAlerts.description: A file was uploaded to blob storage for antivirus scanning ({env} environment)
queryAlerts.query: traces | where message contains 'File Uploaded to blob storage'

queryAlerts.name: ACRVulnerabilities-Critical
queryAlerts.description: Alerts when Defender for Cloud data indicates unresolved Critical ACR image vulnerabilities.
queryAlerts.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(60m) | where RecommendationState =~ 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationSeverity =~ 'Critical' | where AssessedResourceId has '/providers/Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/' | summarize VulnerabilityFindings = count() by AssessedResourceId

queryAlerts.name: ACRVulnerabilities-High
queryAlerts.description: Alerts when Defender for Cloud data indicates unresolved High ACR image vulnerabilities.
queryAlerts.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(60m) | where RecommendationState =~ 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationSeverity =~ 'High' | where AssessedResourceId has '/providers/Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/' | summarize VulnerabilityFindings = count() by AssessedResourceId
